description.value: Tatla Lake Manor / Motel is a family-run motel sitting approximately halfway along the remote Highway 20 corridor in BC's Chilcotin region, 220 km west of Williams Lake — a natural stopping point for cyclists riding toward Bella Coola or back east. The property offers a range of accommodation from basic motel rooms to multi-bedroom fully-equipped kitchen suites, all with private bathrooms. It sits within walking distance of fuel, a post office, health centre, and local shopping, which is a meaningful convenience in this sparsely serviced stretch of the Chilcotin.
